name: kundali

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('server-web/node_modules/@google-cloud/firestore'))try{require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix server-web install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.warn('server-web install skipped:',e.message)}"
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const run=c=>cp.execSync(c,{stdio:'inherit'});if(!fs.existsSync('server-web/node_modules/@google-cloud/firestore')){try{run('npm --prefix server-web install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund')}catch(e){console.warn('server-web install skipped:',e.message)}}if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')||!fs.existsSync('dist/_headers'))run('npm run build');"

description: Kundali: see a real model as a 3D machine, run it in your browser, and test your own computer.
